summary: Protect reusable dependency generations against accidental writes and key private-overlay install inputs.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only cache uses a v2 key combining the original public five-file digest with private install-input identity and requires integrity metadata. Legacy generations are not migrated in place; deployment owners select a fresh cache root.

recovery.detail: Metadata drift triggers diagnostic content verification, leased atomic retirement and source-based repopulation. Read-only mode bits prevent accidental writes but do not isolate hostile same-UID code.
